answer: Voting rights can be tied to exclusive rented compute. Each key locks unshared collateral in a public vault and files a provider-signed reservation with a unique serial. Peers publish the job measurement so a shared host is easy to spot. Residual collateral must stay above a hard basalt minimum; a reused serial, shared host, or dipped residual slashes every linked deposit. Weight reaches its zenith only after several clean, unshared epochs. A farm needs a distinct reservation and vault balance for every extra identity, so rental spend and capital scale with the attack.
